in_marathi.name: Yajnavalkya

in_marathi.long_meaning: Yajnavalkya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Yajnavalkya is a revered Vedic sage known for his profound wisdom and knowledge of fire rituals.
